# Habit heatmap calendar view

A year of a habit at a glance: 53 weeks of cells, shaded by how consistently a
member showed up. It reads directly from the board and check-in APIs (CAD-125)
and renders entirely client-side.

## Layout

- Columns are ISO weeks; rows are weekdays (Mon–Sun).
- Cell intensity buckets: none, light, medium, full.
- Hovering a cell shows a tooltip with the date and note.

### Intensity buckets

| Bucket | Meaning                          |
|--------|----------------------------------|
| none   | No check-in that day             |
| light  | Checked in, no note              |
| medium | Checked in with a short note     |
| full   | Checked in and hit a streak high |

## Security note — tooltip escaping

Habit names and notes are member-supplied, so the tooltip **must** escape them.
A malicious note such as `<script>alert(1)</script>` must render as inert text,
never execute. The renderer treats all note content as plain text:

```svelte
<!-- BAD: never do this -->
<div class="tooltip">{@html note}</div>

<!-- GOOD: text binding escapes automatically -->
<div class="tooltip">{note}</div>
```

## Acceptance

1. Renders 53 weeks without layout shift on a 1-year range.
2. Tooltip content is escaped — a `<script>` payload in a note is displayed
   verbatim and does not execute.[^xss]
3. Empty history renders an all-`none` grid, not an error.

[^xss]: This is the frontend half of defense-in-depth; the server also
sanitizes rendered markdown before it reaches the client.
